admin.reports.position.equationHelp: Each row shows a native-currency position. Cross-currency activity does not have to balance inside each currency; the consolidated base-currency statement is the authoritative accounting equation.
admin.reports.columnHelp.partner: The customer, vendor, or other party connected to the entry.
admin.reports.columnHelp.accountMeaning: Explains whether money is due to the business, owed by it, or already settled.
admin.reports.columnHelp.currency: The original currency in which this value was recorded.
admin.reports.columnHelp.totalAmount: The complete amount recorded before subtracting settled amounts.
admin.reports.columnHelp.settledAmount: The amount already received or paid.
admin.reports.columnHelp.outstandingAmou: The amount that remains to be received or paid.
admin.reports.columnHelp.type: The accounting role of this row, such as income or expense.
admin.reports.columnHelp.account: The ledger account affected by the transaction.
admin.reports.columnHelp.journal: The permanent reference number of the accounting entry.
admin.reports.columnHelp.date: The accounting date on which the entry affects the books.
admin.reports.columnHelp.description: The business reason or explanation recorded for the entry.
admin.reports.columnHelp.source: The operation that created the journal, such as sale, purchase, payment, return, or transfer.
admin.reports.columnHelp.status: Whether the journal is posted, reversed, draft, or voided.
admin.reports.columnHelp.createdBy: The user who originally created the entry.
admin.reports.columnHelp.postedBy: The user who approved and posted the entry to the ledger.
admin.reports.columnHelp.debit: The left side of the journal. It increases debit-normal accounts and decreases credit-normal accounts.
admin.reports.columnHelp.credit: The right side of the journal. It increases credit-normal accounts and decreases debit-normal accounts.
admin.reports.columnHelp.balance: The account amount remaining after the displayed debits and credits.
admin.reports.columnHelp.product: The inventory item whose stock is being reported.
admin.reports.columnHelp.location: The warehouse, store, or other place where the stock is held.
admin.reports.columnHelp.quantity: The number of product units currently available at the location.
admin.reports.columnHelp.positionStatus: Shows whether this currency balances by itself or contains activity paired with another currency.
admin.reports.position.assetsHelp: Assets are what the business owns or is owed: cash, bank money, inventory, equipment, and customer receivables.
admin.reports.position.liabilitiesHelp: Liabilities are amounts the business must pay, such as unpaid vendor bills and other debts.
admin.reports.position.equityHelp: Equity is the owner's investment plus accumulated profit, minus losses and owner withdrawals.
admin.reports.position.adjustmentHelp: Shows value funded by or provided to another currency when one transaction uses two currencies. It is not cash or profit.
admin.accounts.categoryHelp.asset: What the business owns or will receive.
admin.accounts.categoryHelp.liability: What the business owes to others.
admin.accounts.categoryHelp.equity: The owner's investment and accumulated business result.
admin.accounts.categoryHelp.revenue: Income earned from sales or other business activity.
admin.accounts.categoryHelp.expense: Costs incurred to operate the business and earn revenue.
